description: Takes the destination (or all destinations of a multi-country trip) and trip length, plus how the traveler uses data if known. Returns up to 3 options with a reason each: best_fit (cheapest that covers the estimated need), budget (cheaper, below the estimate) and roomier (next size up), each with a link straight to checkout confirmation. Accepts every country of a multi-country trip in destinations, with the total days.

activities.description: Specific uses named by the traveler (e.g. hotspot_light for tethering, video_call, video). Overrides usage. Same categories as bloomyesim.com/data-calculator.

days.description: Trip length in days (total for a multi-country trip).

destination.description: Country name in any of en/ja/zh/ko/es/fr (e.g. "Turkey", "トルコ", "Türkiye") or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("TR"). For one country.

destinations.description: For a trip through several countries: every country visited (names or ISO codes). One eSIM covering all of them is searched. Alternative to destination.

lang.description: Language for names and for the purchase page. Default en when omitted. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present).

min_gb.description: Alternative to usage/activities when the GB wanted is already known.

usage.description: light = maps and messaging, normal = maps, messaging, web and social (default), heavy = plus video streaming. Superseded by activities when given.

wifi.description: How often hotel/cafe Wi-Fi is used. Default sometimes.

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend a plan
